notes.en: The first case, Claude Haiku 5.5, received the package of version 1.0 of this instance, and the cases after it receive the package of version 1.1; the two differ only in the four lines that name the version and the key. Every run is evaluated with the key of version 1.1, which hardened the verifiers (it reads what a page says and where a link points instead of its markup, follows a payment in one cache check and asks for the cause in one error record) before any delivery went through them. Every file of both versions is public on GitHub. An attempt lost before the model could deliver, to the lab or to the operator, is not scored and is rerun; each configuration shows how many. Two clients ran with an exception to the series' rule against bypassing approvals, on a disposable machine with every decision counted: Codex with approvals and sandbox bypassed, OpenCode with its auto-approval flag (its first cases used the default permissions).
